narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Five is a big number, so five is ukasar ukasar ukasar.
<bookmark mark='count'/>Count the coconuts pair by pair, two, four and then six.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Three ukasars make six coconuts, which is one too many for five.
